headline: Approved seven Pawtucket High School construction contracts with Shawmut Design & Construction and a Q2-Q4 Mass Insight contract.
summary: The meeting covered construction updates for the new high school, the status of a city audit, graduation rate audit steps, and homeschool counts. Members approved seven high school construction contracts, a Mass Insight contract, and an Onward We Learn agreement.
decisions: Approved the minutes of September 10, 2026, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School scaffolding package (#029) to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School roofing package (#030) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School drywall package (#031) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School fireproofing package (#032) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School doors, frames, and hardware package (#033) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School food equipment and appliances package (#034) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved a recommendation to award the Pawtucket High School unit masonry package (#035) to Shawmut Design & Construction, unanimously.
Approved the Q2-Q4 Mass Insight contract, unanimously.
Approved the Onward We Learn contract (MOU), unanimously, with no cost associated.
Referred an update to the public participation policy to the policy subcommittee, by consensus.
Approved sealing the executive session minutes, unanimously.
